qe: Which is the largest hot desert in the world, and which narrow water body separates it from the Mediterranean Sea to its north?
qh: दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा उष्ण मरुस्थल कौन-सा है, और उसके उत्तर में भूमध्य सागर को उससे अलग करने वाला संकीर्ण जलभाग कौन-सा है?
e: Duniya ka sabse bada ushna marusthal (hot desert) Sahara hai, jo Africa mahadeep ke uttar bhag me Atlantic se Red Sea tak phaila hua hai; iske aakar me bharat ka bada hissa bhi sama jaayega. Iske uttar me bhoomadhya sagar (Mediterranean Sea) hai aur dono ke beech ka sankirn jal-bhaag Strait of Gibraltar hai, jo Spain tatha Morocco ke beech hai. Saharan se log Europe pahunchane ke liye isi jald-marg ka rasta lete hain. Gobi Asia ki bada thanda marusthal hai (China-Mongolia), isliye woh 'ushna' shreni me nahi aata; Kalahari dakshin Africa ka marusthal hai jo Sahara se chhota hai; Thar bharat-pakistan ki seema par phaila marusthal hai, sabse bada nahi. Antarctica duniya ka sabse bada marusthal mana jaata hai lekin woh thanda (polar) marusthal hai, isliye prashn me 'ushna' shabd ka matlab samajhna zaroori hai. Exam point: sabse bada ushna marusthal = Sahara, aur uska uttari jal-marg = Strait of Gibraltar; sabse bada thanda marusthal = Antarctica.

qe: Which river carries the largest volume of water in the world, although the Nile is longer?
qh: कौन-सी नदी दुनिया में सबसे अधिक जल-मात्रा बहाती है, यद्यपि नील नदी उससे लंबी है?
e: Do alag maap ho sakte hain - lambai (length) aur jal-niryas (discharge). Lambai me Nile sabse aage maani jaati hai (karib 6650 km), lekin jitni matra me paani bahta hai us maamle me Amazon sabse aage hai - woh duniya ki kul nadiyon ki jal-matra ka lagbhag ek-tihai hissa samundar me pahunchati hai. Isi wajah se Amazon ko 'samundar ki dhadkan' bhi kaha jaata hai aur iska jalaashay (basin) South America ke bade hisse ko samet leta hai. Isliye Nile sahi jawab ho hi nahi sakta, kyunki prashn lambai nahi, jal-matra ke baare me hai. Yangtze China ki sabse lambi nadi hai aur Mississippi-Missouri North America ka bada nadi-tantra hai, lekin dono jal-matra me Amazon se peeche hain. Aise prashn me 'longest' aur 'largest' ke antar par dhyan dena zaroori hai. Exam point: lambai me Nile pratham (Africa), jal-matra/discharge me Amazon pratham (South America); Amazon ka basin duniya me sabse bada hai.

qe: The Suez Canal connects which two water bodies, and the Panama Canal connects which two?
qh: स्वेज नहर किन दो जल-निकायों को जोड़ती है, तथा पनामा नहर किन दो जल-निकायों को?
oe: Mediterranean Sea and Red Sea; Atlantic Ocean and Pacific Ocean
Black Sea and Caspian Sea; Atlantic Ocean and Indian Ocean
Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea; Pacific Ocean and Arctic Ocean
Red Sea and Arabian Sea; Pacific Ocean and Indian Ocean
oh: भूमध्य सागर तथा लाल सागर; अटलांटिक महासागर तथा प्रशांत महासागर
काला सागर तथा कैस्पियन सागर; अटलांटिक महासागर तथा हिंद महासागर
भूमध्य सागर तथा काला सागर; प्रशांत महासागर तथा आर्कटिक महासागर
लाल सागर तथा अरब सागर; प्रशांत महासागर तथा हिंद महासागर
e: Suez Canal Egypt me hai aur Bhoomadhya sagar (Mediterranean Sea) tatha Lal sagar (Red Sea) ko jodti hai; 1869 me khuli aur isse Europe tatha Asia ke beech jahaz ko poora Africa ghumne ki zaroorat nahi padti, isliye yatri tatha vyapaar ka rasta bahut chhota ho jaata hai. Doosri sabse mahatvapurn artificial nahar Panama Canal hai, jo Central America me Panama khandh (isthmus) ko kaatkar Atlantic (Caribbean Sea ke raste) tatha Pacific mahasagar ko jodti hai; 1914 me khuli. Black Sea tatha Caspian Sea ko Oos-rup me koi nahar jodta hai - woh ek bandh jalasay hai, isliye doosra vikalp galat hai. Mediterranean tatha Black Sea ko Bosphorus jald-marg jodta hai, par woh nahar nahi hai; isi tarah Lal sagar tatha Arab sagar ko Bab-el-Mandeb jald-marg jodta hai. Panama ka Atlantic tatha Pacific se rishta hai, Indian ya Arctic se nahi. Exam point: Suez = Mediterranean-Red Sea (1869), Panama = Atlantic-Pacific (1914); Bosphorus ek jald-marg hai, nahar nahin.

qe: The Equator passes through how many countries in the world?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा (Equator) दुनिया के कितने देशों से होकर गुजरती है?
e: Bhoomadhya rekha (Equator) duniya ko uttari tatha dakshini golardh me baantti hai aur Africa, South America tatha Asia-Ocenia ke kshetron se hokar jaati hai. Achhe se ginein to kul 13 desh aate hain: Africa me Sao Tome and Principe, Gabon, Republic of the Congo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Somalia; South America me Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador; tatha Asia-Ocenia me Indonesia, Kiribati, Maldives. Isliye 7 ya 10 sahi nahi hai. Bharat ke kisi bhi rajya se bhoomadhya rekha nahi guzarti; bharat se Karkat rekha (Tropic of Cancer) guzarti hai. Ankhon ke samne map rakhein to yaad rakhna aasan hota hai - Africa me 7 desh, South America me 3 desh aur Asia-Ocenia me 3 desh. Sath hi, bhoomadhya rekha par duniya ke sabse bade jal-samuh, Amazon ka muhan, aur Kenya ka bhoomadhya-bindu jaise sthaan jute hain. Exam point: bhoomadhya rekha 13 deshon se guzarti hai (Africa 7, South America 3, Asia-Ocenia 3); bharat se Karkat rekha guzarti hai, bhoomadhya rekha nahi.

qe: 'Ring of Fire' is associated with which ocean, and what is it?
qh: 'रिंग ऑफ फायर' किस महासागर से संबंधित है, और यह क्या है?
oe: Atlantic Ocean; a belt of deep sea trenches with no volcanoes
Pacific Ocean; a horseshoe-shaped belt of high volcanic and earthquake activity
Indian Ocean; a chain of coral islands
Arctic Ocean; a band of permanent ice
oh: अटलांटिक महासागर; गहरे समुद्री खाइयों का पेटी जहाँ ज्वालामुखी नहीं हैं
प्रशांत महासागर; उच्च ज्वालामुखी तथा भूकंप गतिविधि वाला घोड़े की नाल के आकार का पेटी
हिंद महासागर; प्रवाल द्वीपों की श्रृंखला
आर्कटिक महासागर; स्थायी हिम की पट्टी
e: Ring of Fire (agni-vritt) ek ghode ki naal ke aakaar ka pathi hai jo Pacific mahasagar ke kinare-kinare chaln hai - Japan, Philippines, Indonesia, New Zealand ke saath-saath north aur south America ke pashchimi tat tak. Is pathi me duniya ke lagbhag teen-chouthai se adhik jwalamukhi hain aur bade bhookamp bhi yahin aate hain; iski mukhya wajah tectonic plates ka takrana hai, kyunki Pacific plate anya plates ke neeche dhans raha hai (subduction). Atlantic me bhi jwalamukhi hain (jaise Iceland, Canary islands), lekin woh Pacific wale pathi ka hissa nahi hain, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. Indian mahasagar me coral islands hain (Lakshadweep, Maldives), lekin woh agni-vritt nahi hai. Arctic mahasagar me bhi permanent ice ka sambandh is pathi se nahi hai. Japan jaisa desh isi pathi ke karan bhookamp-prone hai. Exam point: Ring of Fire = Pacific mahasagar ka ksaarea, jwalamukhi tatha bhookamp ka kendra, wajah plate subduction; Japan aur Indonesia isi pathi me hain.

qe: The Tropic of Cancer passes through which of the following Indian states?
qh: कर्क रेखा भारत के निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य से होकर गुजरती है?
e: Kark rekha (Tropic of Cancer) bharat ke theek madhya se hokar pashchim se purab ki taraf jaati hai, isliye jo rajya is rekha par padta hai wahi sahi uttar hoga. Rajasthan ka dakshini hissa Kark rekha par hai - Banswara tatha Dungarpur kshetra se yah rekha guzarti hai aur Rajasthan ke aath jilon me iska asar dikhta hai. Kerala bharat ke dakshin me hai, Kark rekha se lagbhag 1000 kilometre dakshin me; isliye woh is rekha par nahi padta. Odisha purab ki taraf hai lekin Kark rekha Odisha se nahi guzarti; Odisha Kark rekha ke thoda dakshin me padta hai. Punjab bharat ke uttar-pashchim me hai, Kark rekha se kaafi uttar me, isliye woh bhi is prashn ka uttar nahi hai. Yaad rahe ki Kark rekha bharat ke aath rajyon se guzarti hai - Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Paschim Banga, Tripura tatha Mizoram; isliye in aath me se koi bhi rajya poochha jaaye to wahi sahi hota hai. Exam point: Kark rekha 8 rajyon se guzarti hai aur Rajasthan unme se ek hai; Kerala, Odisha tatha Punjab is rekha par nahi padte.

qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय तिथि रेखा (International Date Line) क्या है?
oe: A straight line at 0 degree longitude passing through Greenwich
An imaginary zigzag line roughly following the 180 degree meridian, where the date changes by one day
A line at 23.5 degree north latitude
A line at 66.5 degree south latitude
oh: ग्रीनविच से गुजरने वाली 0 अंश देशांतर की सीधी रेखा
लगभग 180 अंश देशांतर का अनुसरण करने वाली काल्पनिक टेढ़ी रेखा, जहाँ तिथि एक दिन बदल जाती है
23.5 अंश उत्तरी अक्षांश पर स्थित रेखा
66.5 अंश दक्षिणी अक्षांश पर स्थित रेखा
e: Duniya me tithi ka hisaab deshaantar (longitude) se juda hai; pratyek 15 degree deshaantar par ek ghanta ka antar banta hai, isliye 180 degree deshaantar par aadha din ka antar ho jaata hai. Isi samasya ko sudharne ke liye International Date Line (antarrashtriya tithi rekha) kalpana ki gayi, jo lagbhag 180 degree deshaantar par chaln ti hai lekin seedhi nahi - woh tezi se (zigzag) mudti hai taaki ek hi rajya, dweep-samuh ya kshetra me do alag tithiyan na hon. Jab aap is line ko pashchim se purab ki taraf paar karte hain to ek din ghatana padta hai, aur purab se pashchim jaate hue ek din badhana padta hai. Greenwich wali 0 degree line ko Prime Meridian kehte hain, jahan se samay gina jaata hai, tithi nahi badalti, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. 23.5 degree north latitude Kark rekha hai aur 66.5 degree south latitude antarrashtriya Date Line se alag, ek akshans rekha hai. Exam point: International Date Line = 180 degree deshaantar ke paas kalpanik tezi se line, jahan tithi ek din badalti hai; Prime Meridian = 0 degree, Greenwich.
